title: Rabbi Bana’ah, Brother of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Ketubot 50b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.50b.5): orphans’ movable property was in his hands, and they came before Shmuel. Hyman identifies him as Ravnai, the brother of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba; see his entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara reads Rabbi Bannai, brother of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba, in the case about orphans’ property. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3217&lang=en) cites this episode under Ravnai and records the Bannai form for it.
Hyman’s heading gives Bana’ah and he identifies this figure with Ravnai in his cross-reference.
